# Third-party licences

Licence texts and attribution notices for dependencies linked by this project.

The zlib licence text is here because the OWD container links zlib
unconditionally. Every other entry in the root NOTICE file records the
dependency, its licence and its status; the corresponding full licence text
is added here when the backend that uses it is actually built.

Nothing in this directory is source code, and no dependency is vendored into
this repository.
